## Not covered / limits (fill in)

Current 4d native proof covers the stated Ubuntu24.04/Wazuh4.14.1 two-host
stock/RELP topology and selected preflight/recovery boundaries. Historical b80
ACL/future-year/audit-module/cohost lifecycle evidence is clearly separated;
there is no current4d rerun claim for those arms. No arbitrary outage, queue
exhaustion, abrupt host loss, natural midnight rollover, universal latency or
exactly-once guarantee follows. Heartbeats share the finite existing queue.

The b80 cold host-OOM/L6 failure, first ACL fixture failure, invalid substring
control and older quiet-stream failure remain failures. UTC restoration does
not prove NTP activation. Retained Wazuh TLS on disable follows the existing
contract; credential decommissioning is not proved. Stop/start cannot establish
sustained quiescence under syslog.socket; validated restart/PID/module checks
support effective reload. Earlier AppArmor/host-missing-module parser attempts
were not discriminating evidence. Final target audit is separate from later
whole-evidence/current-HEAD/CI review.

All target changes were confined to owned disposable VMs, not production or
unrelated VMs. All five synthetic private keys and added signed repository were
test-only. Known-key/private-block scanning is not a universal secret detector.
Machine redaction declares no skipped-source entries; its exact generated scope is preserved.
